newsitem.title: USA: Isis starts Phase I of anti-HIV compound.
newsitem.headline: Isis starts Phase I of anti-HIV compound.

text.p: Isis Pharmaceuticals said on Wednesday that it is beginning Phase I clinical trials of ISIS 5320, an anti-HIV compound.
ISIS 5320 is the first product to enter clinical trials from Isis' combinatorial drug discovery program, the company said.

The Phase I trial, which will serve as the basis of future development of the compound, is intended to determine the maximally tolerated dose, safety, pharmacokinetics and antiviral activity of ISIS 5320 in HIV-1 patients, the company said.
Isis said its ISIS 5320 has been shown in pre-clinical studies to be a potent and specific inhibitor of HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, the company said.

When tested in vitro ISIS 5320 was shown to be active against a broad range of HIV-1 and HIV-2 strains, including both laboratory and clinical isolates as well as drug resistant strains, the company said.
Isis said it expects the Phase I trial to take about six months to complete.
